A1.justification: Both PDFs describe AuroraCap, VDC, and VDCscore. Their complete main text, tables, figures, equations, and appendices S1–S18 support comparison. The reported evaluator change must be accounted for when interpreting otherwise identical scores.

before.justification: v2 reports original AuroraCap benchmark results, token-merging and training ablations, captioning case studies, and human Elo evaluation.

after.justification: v4 retains these original benchmark results, ablations, case studies, and human evaluation in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: Section 3.2.1 and appendices S12, S17, and S18 replace the specified VDCscore LLM component, GPT-4o, with Llama-3.1-8B. This is a bounded component substitution within the retained question-generation, answer-extraction, and answer-matching pipeline. AuroraCap's architecture, training procedure, and token-merging algorithm are unchanged.

E1.justification: Training datasets, evaluation benchmarks, VDC coverage, and appendix test scenarios are unchanged. Section 3.1.2 still specifies GPT-4o for benchmark caption construction; generic LLM labels in S11 do not establish regenerated data.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged across the main and appendix experiments, including vision-blind baselines and alternative caption metrics. The GPT-4o-to-Llama substitution concerns the evaluator, not a competing captioning baseline.

E3.justification: The reported VDCscore protocol replaces GPT-4o with Llama-3.1-8B at all three stages: generating reference questions and answers, extracting predicted answers, and judging correctness and quality. This materially changes the scoring machinery underlying the VDC evaluation. Prompts, aggregation rules, and other settings remain unchanged; the PDFs do not establish whether evaluations were rerun.

E4.justification: Token-retention, slowfast-inference, training-strategy, backbone, and QA-count analyses are retained, as are the qualitative case studies. No analysis comparing the two evaluator models is added.

E5.justification: Correlation analyses and their displays, Elo simulation parameters in Table S12, and run/seed reporting are unchanged. No new uncertainty estimates or statistical testing procedures are documented.

E6.justification: Reported numerical values, rankings, plots, and qualitative examples remain unchanged. For example, Table 6 retains AuroraCap's VDCscore accuracy/score of 38.21/1.98, and Figure 5 retains human-Elo correlation r = 0.86. These unchanged values do not establish equivalent performance under the differently specified evaluators.

T1.justification: The token-merging mathematics, including Equation 1 and Equation S1, and the score-aggregation definitions are unchanged. No formal assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: efficient AuroraCap captioning, the VDC benchmark, and QA-based VDCscore with stronger human alignment. The evaluator substitution does not introduce a new headline claim.

C2.justification: Interpretations of token redundancy, temporal complexity, instruction-following failures, and OCR limitations remain unchanged. v4 adds no explanation or qualification concerning the evaluator substitution.

D1.justification: Evaluator identification changes throughout Section 3.2.1 and S12/S17/S18, and the footnote specifying the September 2024 GPT-4o version is removed. Appendix response labels become generic LLM labels. Training details, hardware information, prompts, and resource-access links otherwise remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The reference list and related-work discussion in S1 are unchanged, including positioning against existing captioning benchmarks and QA-based approaches. No cited work or substantive novelty relationship is added or removed.

P1.justification: Edits are localized to evaluator names, appendix response labels, removal of one acknowledgment sentence, and the arXiv version/date stamp. Section organization and the substantive narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: Removing the evaluator footnote and shortening acknowledgments produces limited text reflow and spacing changes on pages 9–14. Appendix prompt-response labels also change visually. Figures, table structures, axes, legends, and captions are otherwise retained.

improvement.justification: v4 changes the evaluator underlying VDCscore while retaining identical leaderboard results and human-correlation evidence. It does not explain whether this corrects an earlier description or reflects a changed evaluation, and provides no comparison validating the substitution. Its effect on evaluation validity and reproducibility therefore remains unresolved; the remaining edits provide no clear overall quality gain or loss.
